title: Penn State and Victoria Spivey
summary: He played washboard and drums with Victoria Spivey at Penn State.

blocks.x: There wasn't a lot of work. But who were some of the people that you played with during the Sixties and the Seventies, besides Tony Parenti and Graham Stewart? Who were some of the others, even if you played like one-nighters here in the New York area or in New Jersey? And before we get to Cathy Chamberlain, because that's when your career begins to take an upswing again.
Who were some of the musicians?
Yes. You played at the State College of Pennsylvania during the 1970's?
Who did you go up there with? There's a photograph of you sitting up there.
I think the first time I was there was with the one who plays a lot... Spivers... What's her name?

Uh-huh. I was playing washboard playing drums and her singing. And recently I've been doing the same thing now with Cathy Chamberlain. I've got a big book about that thick with all the pictures and all the names. I've got a big drum ...(?)... with an automobile on top of it.
